reason: Naan JustDial-la rendu moonu number call pannitu than aalu edukuven, but pathi per phone eduthadhe illa, fake listing dhan. Idhula identity verification iruku nu sonnudhadhal, oru try edukalam nu nenaikiren, konjam risk kammi irukum nu feel aguthu.
objection: Freelancer varaama po-na illa work bad-a irundha, enaku refund kudupanga illa, adha pathi app-la onnum sollama irukanga -- adhu dhan enaku main doubt.
would_change_my_mind: A clear no-show or bad-job refund/guarantee stated upfront -- adha mattum sonna, confidence-a book pannuven.
